title: MACA route qualification remains incomplete for exact retained controls
observation: Seven unchanged retained sources are parsed and assessed by the successor without provider or GPU work. They are semantically accepted. Six still have localized route blockers; the fixed single-stage Softmax unroll instead lowers under the already integrated partial-unroll implementation. These are exact Schedule/Target/backend distinctions, not conclusions from a rejection count. C550's declared1024 threads and64 lanes allow16 groups within the Target's thread limit; this does not qualify that launch on the MACA route. The Target declares no per-thread register cap, and maxnreg enforcement remains a separate unverified toolchain contract.

gaps.commitments: One execution group; residency registers_per_thread64 and ctas_per_multiprocessor2.
gaps.disposition: Defer until the exact MACA option's enforcement is demonstrated and any required Target register fact is declared by its owner. API keyword availability, compiled-resource counts and another vendor's maxnreg behavior do not prove enforcement. Retain the refusal; changing the author-requested budget is not a lowering repair.

gaps.commitments: Role execution_groups0 through15; no inferred hardware-thread-limit violation.
gaps.disposition: Defer the route enlargement beyond its existing eight-group qualification. Require bounded build, launch, correctness, measurement and attribution evidence on this exact Target and runtime before widening the evidence set. Keep the declared groups unchanged at rejection.

gaps.commitments: Two sibling K loops, tile256, factor2, stages4 and2.
gaps.disposition: The fixed single-stage repair in F-2026-10-04-005 does not cover this pipelined combination. Retain both requested stage counts and the unroll factor; do not silently serialize or remove the pipeline. Faithful spelling and route qualification remain deferred. Separate native results in005 do not qualify this residual-RMSNorm candidate.

gaps.commitments: Two execution groups; two tile256 sibling loops, stages4 and2, each warp_specialize=true.
gaps.disposition: Defer until the route realizes and qualifies the exact role, synchronization and loop-option combination. IR already carries the decision. Do not inherit NVIDIA's specialization evidence or invent a new backend. This assessment does not promise the candidate will become admissible after one gate is removed.

existing_successor_resolution.commitments: Fixed single-stage tile64 loop, trip count16, explicit factor8.
existing_successor_resolution.result: The unchanged source assesses lowering_eligible and lowers atf0393c92 through main's faithful divisible-group implementation. This software result is not device correctness or performance confirmation for the old Run. The original rejection remains unchanged.

proposed_change: Keep these controls visible and their qualification refusals explicit. Curate the exact follow-up proof obligations at the owning route, while shared diagnosis routing reports expressibility separately from qualification. New hardware work requires separate admission and a successor Run; this record authorizes none.
promotion_disposition: No route capability or Compiler performance promotion. The deferred controls and original Runs remain unchanged; the diagnostic clarification does not close a qualification finding.
